answers.p1: `--yes` must be passed, because a rename cannot be undone by hand.
answers.p2: It is a lowercase, hyphenated slug, e.g. `harbour-walk` in `2026-04-02_harbour-walk.jpg`.
answers.p5: The planner refuses (treats it as a collision) instead of adding a suffix.
answers.p6: The undo command has not been started.
answers.p7: Undo command, then the `--pattern` option, then docs.
